en: A black-and-white image showing the interior of a rustic wooden room, likely from a historical Scandinavian house. The scene features a long wooden table with benches, set with bowls and plates, and a wooden dresser displaying metal and ceramic plates and pitchers. Decorative woodwork and candleholders give the room a traditional, old-fashioned feel. The text at the bottom left reads 'INTERIØR FRA BÆRFROSTUEN.'
